description: Fourth app-level set, authored 2026-11-19 and committed BEFORE the fixes for the two remaining app_cases_v3 failures (weekend words before the measure; questions needing outside data such as market share) and before any run on it. No question repeats a v1-v3 question. Two or three new questions per failure type, plus questions that must keep working near those fixes (shares of the company's own totals, weekend filters, day of week). Same method as v1-v3 (evaluation/run_app_evaluation.py). Share references use measures or CALCULATE inside ADDCOLUMNS so the denominator follows the row (the v2/v3 share references did not; see docs/EVALUATION.md 3.8). Written by the developer who also writes the fixes.

cases.question: Weekends compared with weekdays: net sales in 2024
How do we compare with our competitors?
What is the market size for snacks in Riyadh?
Snacks share of net sales by region
cases.reference_dax: EVALUATE ADDCOLUMNS(VALUES('DimStore'[Region]), "C", "Snacks", "N", CALCULATE([Net Sales], 'DimProduct'[Category] = "Snacks"), "S", DIVIDE(CALCULATE([Net Sales], 'DimProduct'[Category] = "Snacks"), [Net Sales]))

cases.question: Share of units sold by store type
cases.reference_dax: EVALUATE ADDCOLUMNS(VALUES('DimStore'[StoreType]), "U", [Units Sold], "S", DIVIDE([Units Sold], CALCULATE([Units Sold], ALL('DimStore'[StoreType]))))

cases.question: Which day of the week has the most orders?
cases.reference_dax: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('DimDate'[DayName], "O", DISTINCTCOUNT('FactSales'[OrderID])) ORDER BY [O] DESC
